import pandas as pd

data = {
    "receipt": ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"],
    "mode": ["Bus", "Bus", "Rail", "Rail", "Ferry", "Ferry"],
    "cost": [2, 4, 5, 9, 6, 10],
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
means = df.groupby("mode")["cost"].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax.bar(means.index, means.values)
ax.set(title="Travel expense receipts", xlabel="mode", ylabel="Mean cost")
ax.set_ylim(bottom=3)
